subject: Recap + next steps: POC prompt set & eval dataset collection (ACMEcorp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordane@acmecorp.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Recap: POC success criteria & prompt dataset request

Thanks again for the time today - good conversation. Quick recap of the POC goals and a clear ask on the prompt/log dataset so we can get the eval started:

Summary of success criteria (what we'll measure):
- Relevance/accuracy: >= 85% on your internal rubric across priority intents (billing, account changes, product troubleshooting).
- Latency: median inference latency < 300ms for 512-token requests on Dedicated config.
- Safety/compliance: zero high-severity PII leakage on sampled outputs.
- UX quality: end-to-end success rate >= 90% for the top 3 flows.

Evaluation plan (high level):
1) You provide a representative prompt set + sample system logs (redacted) and a short rubric.
2) We run the prompts against our candidate models and report accuracy, latency, and safety metrics.
3) We iterate on prompt templates and caching/batching config; we do one retest.

Dataset ask (what we need from ACME):
- Prompt set: ~200 representative prompts covering 4 priority intents (rough distribution noted in the attached template). CSV preferred: columns = prompt_id, intent, user_message, context, expected_label, redact_flag.
- Sample logs: 1-2 small log files that show typical system context we might include (please redact PII).
- Rubric: 1-pager describing pass/fail criteria and any weighting across intents.

Timeline & ownership:
- Please aim to share the dataset by EOD 2027-04-22 so we can run an initial evaluation the week of 04/25.
- ACME owner: Jordan Ellis (you mentioned you'll lead).
- Redwood owners: Marissa (sales lead) + Aditya (inference lead).

Attachments: attached a short CSV template (redwood-prompt-template-v1.csv) to make formatting easy.

Questions / open items:
- Are there any internal compliance constraints around logs we should know about?
- Do you need more time to anonymize? If so, suggest a new date.

Next step: Jordan, if you can upload the CSV + logs to the Drive link I sent or reply here with files, we'll confirm the kickoff window.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Ellis <jordane@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: POC success criteria & prompt dataset request

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear summary. We're aligned on the success criteria. A few notes:

- We're attaching our first pass (acmecorp-prompt-collection-2027.csv) and a small logs sample (system-logs-sample.txt). The CSV follows your template but a couple fields are internal-only (we flagged those in a separate column).
- On redaction: we'll remove direct PII but will leave contextual identifiers (e.g., "account_type: enterprise") so the eval reflects real traffic. Is that OK for you?
- Timeline: we're pushing to get the cleaned dataset over by 2027-04-22 but Priya suggested we might need until 2027-04-24 depending on legal review. Can you accommodate a 1-2 day slip?

Attachments: acmecorp-prompt-collection-2027.csv, system-logs-sample.txt

Jordan
Sr. Product Manager, ACMEcorp
jordane@acmecorp.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordane@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: POC success criteria & prompt dataset request

Jordan - thanks for the files. Quick technical notes:

- Redaction approach: leaving contextual identifiers is fine; please remove direct identifiers (emails, full names, account numbers). If you prefer, we can run a quick automated scrub on our side and provide a redacted copy before eval (we'd need a signed DPA addendum for logs).
- CSV schema: we expect UTF-8 CSV with these columns: prompt_id, intent, user_message, context, expected_label, redact_flag. We saw a couple rows with newline characters in the "context" column - fine, but please wrap fields in quotes.
- Sample size: 200 prompts is great. If you can provide a balanced sample across intents (see suggested distribution in the template) that will make the initial metrics meaningful.

I'll schedule a short 30-min kickoff for Mon 2027-04-25 to walk through the eval plan and acceptance rubric. If you push to 04/24 for dataset delivery that's OK - we'll start the run ASAP after receipt.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Lead, Inference Engineering
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordane@acmecorp.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmecorp.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: POC success criteria & prompt dataset request

Great - thanks for the quick turnaround, Jordan and Aditya.

Confirmed next steps:
- ACME to deliver final dataset by 2027-04-24 (Jordan/Priya). If legal needs extra time, updated delivery by 2027-04-26 is acceptable - please confirm asap.
- Kickoff call: Mon 2027-04-25 at 10:00 AM PT (30 min) - invite sent to calendar. Agenda: evaluation plan, rubric alignment, success criteria walkthrough, logistics for data transfer.
- Redwood will prepare initial run and share a results packet (metrics + sample outputs + safety review) within 48 hours of receipt.

HubSpot: I linked the deal for easy tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2027-POC-42
DocuSign: I'll circulate the SOW/POC addendum after kickoff if legal confirms.

See you on the 25th.

- Marissa
